scenario: A telecommunications customer locked out of their account (lost SIM) submits an account recovery request with a government-issued photo ID, a live selfie, and their account registration details. The agent pipeline: (1) verify the identity document and extract structured fields, (2) compare the selfie to the ID portrait for biometric confirmation, (3) generate a recovery decision memo summarizing all verification signals.
info_flow: didit-id-verification parses the customer's government ID and outputs structured identity fields including document metadata → didit-face-match compares the customer's live selfie to the ID portrait and returns a similarity score with a threshold-based verdict → reporting assembles all signals into a recovery decision memo with an approve or deny recommendation.
